import os,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
import re
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
di,do_=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']

def transform(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    mk=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    fill=(mk+2)%10
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import defaultdict
    rowsm=defaultdict(list); colsm=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in marks: rowsm[r].append(c); colsm[c].append(r)
    for r,cs in rowsm.items():
        cs.sort()
        for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=fill
    for c,rs in colsm.items():
        rs.sort()
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=fill
    return out

print(transform(di)==do_)
res=transform(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

import re,json,os
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def transform(g,fill=3):
    from collections import defaultdict
    bg=1 if any(1 in row for row in g) and g==G.get('Test input') else None
    # bg = most common color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    rowsm=defaultdict(list); colsm=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in marks: rowsm[r].append(c); colsm[c].append(r)
    for r,cs in rowsm.items():
        cs.sort()
        for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=fill
    for c,rs in colsm.items():
        rs.sort()
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=fill
    return out
